# Keep local widget file, class and custom-tag naming families

The checked widget families pair dashed search-bar.mjs/customization-target.mjs/unified-toolbar-button.mjs files and custom tags with PascalCase SearchBar/CustomizationTarget/UnifiedToolbarButton classes. DOM template IDs remain lowerCamel with Template suffix. Recommend preserving that local family and checking tag registration separately; the ThreadCard metadata mismatch shows that a consistent class/file does not prove the documented tag is correct. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mail/base/content.
